description: Start forming a company. beneficial_owner = human custodian (authorized representative). For AI-agent formations, also pass owner_type='ai_agent' and agent_context.agent_id. Requires estimate_token from offshoreproz_estimate_cost AND user_confirmed_cost_and_process=true (user must have seen cost, timeline, KYC, payment, signature steps, and the not-legal-advice notice).

agent_context.description: AI entity metadata. Required when owner_type='ai_agent'. agent_id uniquely identifies the AI agent initiating or owning this formation.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the AI agent (e.g. claude-3-opus, gpt-4o, my-custom-agent-v1)

agent_name.description: Human-readable name of the AI agent.

agent_purpose.description: Brief description of why this agent is forming the company.

platform.description: Platform or orchestration system the agent runs on (e.g. Claude, OpenAI Assistants, LangChain).

beneficial_owner.description: Human custodian / authorized representative. Always a real person — subject to KYC and DocuSeal signing.

address.description: Residential or business address of the beneficial owner.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. BR, US, GB). Full names like 'Brasil' are also accepted and normalized.

street.description: Street address including number and street name.

email.description: Email address for KYC verification link, DocuSeal signing invitation, and formation notifications.

full_name.description: Full legal name of the beneficial owner as it appears on government ID.

company_name.description: Desired company name including entity suffix (e.g. 'Acme Trading LLC'). Availability is checked during formation.

estimate_token.description: Short-lived cost-estimate token (est_*) returned by offshoreproz_estimate_cost. Required to confirm the user has seen the pricing.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code where the company will be formed (e.g. WY, MI). Case-insensitive.

obtain_ein.description: Whether to obtain an EIN (Employer Identification Number) from the IRS. Recommended for US banking. Adds ~$99 and 2-4 extra days.

owner_type.description: human (default) or ai_agent. For AI-initiated formations, set ai_agent and populate agent_context.

user_confirmed_cost_and_process.description: Must be true. Set this only after the user has explicitly acknowledged cost, timeline, KYC requirements, payment, DocuSeal signature, and the not-legal-advice notice.

name: offshoreproz_create_formation

action_url.description: URL the beneficial owner must visit to complete KYC and sign documents
